scope: Read-only dial research; no Blender/render, geometry, artwork, pivot, source angle or contract changes.

photo_inspection.variant_caveat: RDC125HD page / BM150 USB feature filename; exact OEM variant not certified.

data.excluded: 0 occluded by needle,20 uncertain. Artwork-plan boxes are approximate and not independent new points.

point_uncertainty_px.kind: inherited approximate manual reading, not measured Gaussian sigma

data.native_uv: u right, v down, origin top-left

assumptions: The 16 printed rim anchors lie near one planar circular border; plane/circle are hypotheses, not certified facts.
The six major-mark anchors lie on equally spaced positive radial directions; their distances from centre are NOT forced equal.
The local homography uses theta40=0 and theta(s)=-(s-40)/20*delta.
Normalized image coordinates have arbitrary origin taken from input ellipse and scale80px; this is not a measured physical pivot.
A conic has projective ambiguities; varying the angular step can be offset by changes in rectification and projected centre.
Camera intrinsics, lens/glass refraction, printed mark radial support and exact coplanarity are unmeasured.

method.residuals: Approximate Sampson conic normal distance plus signed perpendicular image distance anchor→projected radial line. Neither is full 2D footprint error.
method.weight: Both residual classes divided by3px; a working normalization, not statistical noise calibration.
method.initialization: Ellipse from retained rim points and phase from first retained anchor only; conditional common-radius initialization then final radial-direction fit.
method.validation: Each mark held out in turn; four interleaved groups of4rim points held out. All from one photo, not independent views.
method.sensitivity: 120 independent coordinate perturbations uniform[-3,3]px, seed4440, free-step projective refits. This is not a probability model or a confidence interval.
method.limits: One deterministic initialization per fit, no proof of globally optimal or exhaustive feasible parameter set.

sampled_profile.interpretation: Diagnostic approximate normal-distance cut only. NOT a rigorous ±3px coordinate feasibility region, angular uncertainty interval, or hidden source measurement.

conditional_working_projection.status: estimated comparison aid only; not a calibrated camera or source pivot
conditional_working_projection.input_unit_radius: dimensionless comparison circle; no physical radius used
conditional_working_projection.centre_status: Estimated by this fit, NOT independently read needle hub or imposed asset pivot.

findings.claim: A conditional projective comparison can reduce the affine angular inconsistency without changing v1 angles.
findings.evidence: Fixedv1 ray train max1.623px vs affine6.713px; held-out max4.996px. It does not substantiate full-point2px accuracy.

findings.claim: The free angular increment is not identified from these approximate points.
findings.evidence: Free fit35.762deg improves training but worsens heldoutmax to7.115px. Perturbations23.165..41.095deg are sensitivity results, not a confidence interval.
Projective fixed40deg held-out max7.024px vs4.996px fixedv1; same-photo local fits do not prove either OEM increment.

findings.claim: Common outer-anchor radius is an extra unsupported restriction.
findings.evidence: Preliminary common-radius model fixedv1 had trainmax2.533px and heldoutmax5.514px; it is not the preferred final model. No common-radius results are used to establish geometry.

decision: Do not move source angles, pivot, font, printed marks or model from this study. Conditional homography may be used only for labeled same-photo comparison.
next_evidence: Independently annotate the visible needle hub/pivot with honest native uncertainty; do not reuse the asset pivot as a photo observation.
Re-read both endpoints/centreline of several major radial marks, distinguishing broad wedge tips from radial lines; preserve their uncertainty.
Acquire a clearer0/20 region and a genuinely independent coplanar view of this same variant.
Use a held-out centre/line observation or a second view before selecting an angular increment or asserting calibration.
technical_and_artistic_acceptance: No model receipt, metric calibration, OEM conformity, or artistic acceptance.
